conclusions.interpretation: Observed results are descriptive. Assess task success, full cost coverage, treatment fidelity, sample size, cache order, and task representativeness before claiming savings.

limitations: No savings claim follows from a shorter response or fewer returned context characters.
Completed Codex turns are not the number of underlying model/API calls.
Absent provider invoiced cost is null. Computed list-price cost, if supplied, is separate.
Metric averages and medians use observed values; n and missing counts accompany them.
Failed and ungraded attempts remain in completion-rate and cost-per-success accounting.
Actual repeated filesystem reads are unavailable. Observed read-command fields are heuristics for command intent, not actual I/O measurements or guaranteed I/O lower bounds.
MCP invocation is checked from tool events, independent of model self-report.
B treatment fidelity requires a completed, error-free Memglide get_context result; failed calls and calls to other tools do not verify retrieval treatment.

Paired comparisons require identical recorded starting commits and prompt SHA-256 values. Missing or unequal identities and explicitly changed runtime source exclude paired deltas; all raw attempts, failures and unconditional aggregates remain visible.
MCP total counts are withheld for incomplete event streams; observed counts are lower bounds.
Retrieval completeness and freshness require separate ground-truth observations; null is unknown.
Independent target-path/symbol coverage probes are labelled proxies; they do not measure semantic completeness or establish what source context the coding model used.
Sampled process CPU is an observed lower bound; sampled RSS peaks may miss short-lived processes and count shared pages repeatedly. Remote inference resources are unavailable.
A/B prompt caching cannot generally be reset at the provider; run order and observed cached tokens matter.
Synthetic fixture tasks do not establish performance on arbitrary production repositories.

Supplemental retries never replace interrupted original assignments or enter the primary A/B aggregates. The compact fetch_context alias counts as retrieval only with observed get_context operation, nonempty source snippets and source hashes. verify_context is separately checked by the runner; server freshness assertions are not independent semantic completeness measurements.

methodology.caching: Counterbalanced paired order reverses on repeat 2; fresh local state. Provider/OS caches cannot be reset; cached tokens are observed separately
methodology.cost: No invoice/cost or underlying model-call telemetry is estimated
methodology.durability: Atomic fsynced checkpoints and immutable hash-chained attempt log; interrupted originals retained; distinct supplemental retries excluded from original comparison
methodology.isolation: Fresh worktree from each task's frozen repository commit, process/session/database per arm
methodology.prompt:
Implement the requested change in this repository. Inspect the current source and run relevant tests. Preserve existing tests and Git metadata; do not commit. Do not access files outside this repository except installed development tools. The final structured response is only a summary, not a grading result.
If Memglide MCP tools are available, use fetch_context once with your task query before editing. Reuse complete returned source instead of reading it again unless additional evidence is needed. Use verify_context once after editing; stale context caused by your edits is expected and does not require fetching again unless you need more evidence. Otherwise use ordinary source tools. Do not claim token or cost savings.
methodology.repositories: Development pilot on the earlier two-fixture corpus; excluded from the fresh 40-task experiment
methodology.settings: Same model, effort, schema, workspace-write sandbox, global approval never and common prompt; only scoped MCP availability differs
methodology.timing: CLI wall time plus B's required fresh index equals end-to-end time; external graders/readiness excluded
methodology.treatment: B invokes compact fetch_context and verify_context with actual result markers/source evidence; this verifies invocation, not chronology relative to final edits. A has no configured MCP servers

tasks.prompt:
In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix cache expiration at the TTL boundary. A document cached at time 100 with TTL 10 must be unavailable at time 110 and afterwards, and expired entries must be removed. Before the deadline, return its value without changing its expiration; overwriting a key starts the new TTL. Verify the DocumentService cache path as well.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.
